metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1971 · Johnny Got His Gun
metas.description: During World War I, a patriotic young American is rendered blind, deaf, limbless, and mute by a horrific artillery shell attack. Trapped in what's left of his body, he desperately looks for a way to end his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1980 · Breaker Morant
metas.description: Three Australian lieutenants are court martialed for executing prisoners as a way of deflecting attention from war crimes committed by their superior officers.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1986 · When the Wind Blows
metas.description: A naive elderly British rural couple survive the initial onslaught of a nuclear war.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1977 · The Ascent
metas.description: Two Soviet partisans on a mission to gather food contend with the winter cold, the occupying Germans, and their own psyches.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 1985 · Shoah
metas.description: Claude Lanzmann's epic documentary recounts the story of the Holocaust through interviews with witnesses - perpetrators as well as survivors.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1989 · The Winter War
metas.description: In 1939, two Finnish brothers are conscripted in the army to fight in the war between Finland and the Soviet Union.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1974 · Lacombe, Lucien
metas.description: In 1944, an 18-year-old boy from small-town France collaborates with the Gestapo and subsequently falls in love with a Jewish girl.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1976 · The Fifth Seal
metas.description: In Budapest in 1944, a watchmaker, a book seller and a carpenter are drinking in a bar with the owner, when they are joined by a stranger. The watchmaker asks a hypothetical question that will change their lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1975 · Seven Beauties
metas.description: The defense of honor, a strong value in Neapolitan society, and its effects on the life of everyman Pasquale Frafuso.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1974 · Hearts and Minds
metas.description: A startling and courageous landmark documentary that unflinchingly confronted the United States' involvement in Vietnam at the height of the controversy that surrounded it.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1974 · Only Old Men Are Going to Battle
metas.description: During World War II, a Soviet veteran pilot teaches newcomers that war is transient, and music is eternal.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1975 · The Old Gun
metas.description: During World War II, a peaceful French surgeon decides to ruthlessly exterminate an SS squad because of the atrocities they'd just committed in his countryside home and childhood village.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1972 · The Dawns Here Are Quiet
metas.description: During World War II in a small village outpost, a Soviet sergeant has his troop replaced by an all female unit. As they finally begin to appreciate one another, German paratroopers are spotted nearby and the realities of war emerge.
